# IEEE8500 B0-only stress calibration

**IEEE8500_STRESS_CALIBRATED_B0_AUTHORITY**

Final source pu = **1.04**, all-regulator Vreg = **123.5 V**, alpha8500 = **0.5**.

The original **(source pu=1.045, alpha8500=0.25)** evidence and authority remain unchanged as the voltage-feasible compatibility authority. This new artifact is a separate stress-calibrated B0 authority. It is a reduced-load study adaptation, **not canonical IEEE8500 reproduction**.

The fixed target **0.85 pu maximum phase-line loading** was defined before execution as a stressed-but-feasible large-feeder baseline, not as an instruction to reproduce an IEEE123 result. All **100 combinations / 9,600 chronological B0 AC slots** were freshly evaluated. Source grid: 1.0450, 1.0425, 1.0400, 1.0375, 1.0350; common Vreg grid: 125.0, 124.5, 124.0, 123.5 V; alpha grid: 0.40, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, 0.60.

Selection first discards every case with any physical, convergence or control-settling failure. It then minimizes the unrounded lexicographic key **(|line maximum−0.85|, |Vreg−125|, |source−1.05|, −alpha)**. No grid refinement or post-result tuning is performed.

Hard limits remain 0.95–1.05 pu voltage at all 8639 nodes and loading ≤1.0 pu for both active line terminals, transformer phase currents and every transformer winding apparent power. The prior numerical boundary tolerance 1e-9 is unchanged. Each case starts with a fresh engine and carries accepted tap/cap states through 96 sequential slots; MaxIterations=100 and MaxControlIterations=1000 remain unchanged. Five isolated source processes have no shared control state.

Native topology, impedance, original line/transformer ratings, 12 AIDC PCCs and 24 MESS service PCCs across 24 service locations, and AIDC/MESS power/energy/GPU scales are unchanged. Selected date 2025-05-21, causal D-1 demand/PV temporal inputs, native P/Q/PF and proportional PV phase allocation are preserved. Controlled capacitors/CapControls, PT ratio=60, band=2 V and tap limits are unchanged; CAPBank3 stays OFF. No Actual, B1/B2/B3, sensitivity or optimization performance input is used.

**51 / 100 cases are feasible.** Selected target error: **0.001230859630 pu**.
